title: Food & shopping
grammar: Like / love / hate / don't like (+ verbo-ING e substantivo) + some / any + How much is it?
today: Hoje você vai aprender a dizer o que você ama e o que você odeia, a perguntar se tem alguma coisa no mercado e a perguntar o preço.
canDo: Dizer o que você ama, gosta e odeia: I love shopping. I hate apples.
Usar some e any: There are some apples. Are there any bananas?
Perguntar e dizer preços: How much is it? It's 250 dollars.

video.context: Na brincadeira, alguém está vendendo a "granny mobile", a scooter da vovó. E começa a negociação do preço.
video.predict: Quanto você acha que vão pedir pela scooter? E o comprador vai ter dinheiro?

options: A girl sells the granny mobile.

questions.q: It's too long! What do you hear?

vocab: Are you going to buy it?

lines.text: On Thursday at 10, Tony and Jenny are at the supermarket.
I love shopping! Are there any apples?
Yes, there are some apples over there.
I hate apples. I love melons!
OK. How much is the big melon?
It's 50 dollars.
50 dollars?! That's very expensive!
Tony, there aren't any cheap melons here.
**Well**, Tony only has 20 dollars.
**Actually**... I like apples now. How much are they?
They're 2 dollars. Very cheap!
**So** Tony buys some apples. And Jenny buys the big melon... for Tony!

questions.q: How much is the big melon?

chunks.tip: Buy é comprar uma coisa (Tony buys some apples). Shopping é o passeio de fazer compras: I love shopping = eu amo fazer compras. Lembra: com he/she ganha -S: she buys.
examples: And Jenny buys the big melon... for Tony!

practice.pt: A Rosa compra o melão grande para o Max.
practice.en: Rosa buys the big melon for Max.

chunks.tip: Expensive (caro) tem som de "iks-PÉN-siv". Cheap (barato) é com "tchíip" longo. E pra reclamar do preço: That's very expensive!
examples: Tony, there aren't any cheap melons here.

practice.pt: Não tem nenhuma banana barata aqui.
practice.en: There aren't any cheap bananas here.
alt: There are not any cheap bananas here.

chunks.tip: Depois de love, like, hate: coisa (I love melons) ou verbo com -ING (I love shopping). E "gostar DE" não tem "of": I like apples. Pra negar: I don't like apples / She doesn't like apples.
examples: I hate apples. I love melons!

practice.pt: Eu odeio bananas. Eu amo laranjas!
practice.en: I hate bananas. I love oranges!

chunks.tip: SOME na frase afirmativa (there are some apples = tem umas maçãs). ANY na pergunta (Are there any apples? = tem maçã?) e na negativa (there aren't any = não tem nenhuma).
examples: Yes, there are some apples over there.
Tony, there aren't any cheap melons here.

practice.en: Yes, there are some bananas over there.

practice.pt: Não tem nenhuma laranja barata aqui.
practice.en: There aren't any cheap oranges here.
alt: There are not any cheap oranges here.

chunks.chunk: How much is it? / How much are they?
chunks.tip: Uma coisa: How much IS it? → It's 50 dollars. Várias: How much ARE they? → They're 2 dollars. E as centenas: 120 = one hundred twenty, 250 = two hundred fifty.
examples: How much is the big melon?
How much are they? They're 2 dollars.

practice.en: How much is the big banana?
How much are they? They're 5 dollars.
alt: How much are they? They are 5 dollars.
How much are they? They're five dollars.

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: I don't like bananas. / She doesn't like bananas.
Eu não gosto de bananas. / Ela não gosta de bananas.
Are there any apples? — There aren't any apples.
Tem maçã? — Não tem nenhuma maçã.
How much is it? — It's 50 dollars.
How much are they? — They're 250 dollars (two hundred fifty).
grammar.tip: Love / like / hate + verbo com -ING: I love cooking. SOME na afirmativa, ANY na pergunta e na negativa. E preço: uma coisa = How much IS it?, várias = How much ARE they? Falou, validou! 🚀

gossips.title: Max Loves Expensive Things

lines.text: It's Saturday at 9. Carlos and Max are at the pet shop.
Max's bed is very old.
Max! There are some cheap beds here. The blue bed is 20 dollars.
Max doesn't like the blue bed. He loves the big red bed.
How much is the red bed?
It's 250 dollars.
250 dollars?! Max, I hate shopping with you!
**So** Carlos buys the cheap blue bed. At home, Max hates it.
**Actually**, Max sleeps on Carlos's bed now. Carlos sleeps on the couch!

options: Max loves a very expensive bed.
Carlos buys the cheap blue bed.

gossips.title: Tony's Secret Lasagna

lines.text: Tony is gonna cook for Jenny on Friday at 7.
Rosa, I love cooking! Do you have any tomatoes?
Yes, I have some tomatoes. Do you have any pasta?
No, I don't have any pasta. I have some bananas.
Bananas? Tony... do you like cooking?
**Well**... **to be honest**, I love eating.
There's a big lasagna in Rosa's kitchen.
Rosa, how much is your lasagna?
For you? 120 dollars.
**Let's say** 40?
**Let's say** 90. And it's our secret.
**Deal!**

realtimes.title: O Carlos no supermercado
realtimes.pt: Na segunda, às 6, o Carlos está no supermercado. Ele ama cozinhar, mas odeia fazer compras. Tem umas laranjas baratas: 3 dólares. Mas não tem nenhuma banana. O Carlos pergunta: quanto é o melão grande? É 15 dólares. Muito caro! Então o Carlos compra umas laranjas. E o Max? O Max odeia laranjas.
realtimes.model: On Monday at 6, Carlos is at the supermarket. He loves cooking, but he hates shopping. There are some cheap oranges: 3 dollars. But there aren't any bananas. Carlos asks: How much is the big melon? It's 15 dollars. Very expensive! So Carlos buys some oranges. And Max? Max hates oranges.

realtimes.title: Os tênis amarelos
realtimes.pt: Eu amo fazer compras no sábado. Eu gosto de frutas, mas não gosto de laranjas. Na loja ao lado do supermercado tem uns tênis azuis. Quanto custam? 180 dólares! Muito caro. Tem algum tênis barato? Tem: uns tênis amarelos, 40 dólares. Eu odeio amarelo... mas eu vou comprar os tênis amarelos.
